consumer: Shadow-plan whether a public GitHub CLI issue title belongs in a bug or enhancement triage queue. Never change labels, issues, or assignments.

state.title: The command crashes when the repository name is short

issue_kind.instructions: From the issue title alone, is the main request to fix existing behavior, add or improve a capability, or is there too little/contradictory evidence? Classify the requested change, not the emotional tone. Do not infer facts absent from the title. The issue's existing labels are not supplied.

criteria.bug: Existing behavior is reported as broken, incorrect, unexpectedly missing, crashing, or failing against an implied current expectation.
criteria.enhancement: The request seeks a new capability, supported case, optional behavior, or deliberate improvement, without clear evidence of a current defect.
criteria.unclear: The title is too vague, mixes defect and feature requests, or does not show which distinction applies.

existing_behavior_failure.instructions: Does the issue title affirmatively describe existing behavior failing or behaving incorrectly? A wish for a new capability alone is not a failure.

criteria.true: An existing behavior failure or incorrect result is described.
criteria.false: No existing behavior failure is stated, or the title is insufficient.

uncertainty_policy: Missing title, invalid/provider response, unclear or conflicting semantic signals, or a below-threshold answer plans human_review.
code_owned_checks: Only the issue title, not maintainer labels or expected disposition, is sent to Jev
Bind response to exact state, question version, and versioned model
Apply fixed thresholds in side-effect-free consumer; do not change GitHub issues

follow_up.new_evidence: An authorized, privacy-screened issue body excerpt in a separately versioned study
follow_up.stop_condition: This pilot uses titles only; route uncertainty to human review.

evaluation_scope: Exploratory held-out shadow comparison to pre-existing maintainer labels; labels are imperfect proxies and this is not production qualification.
